description: One of a connected game’s own numbers from Roblox’s analytics, day by day (oldest first, Roblox’s UTC days): dau (daily active users), mau, playu (playtime minutes per daily user), session (minutes), d1, d7, d30 (retention), payers (share who pay), revenue (Robux a day), imp (people shown it), plays (people who played). Robux and payers only where they’re not just a guest. Comes back as a dataset too: day (20261021) and the number (rates as fractions).

game.description: One of their games: its name or universe id
